browser_target.limits: Installed version only, isolated profile, synthetic keyboard/composition/clipboard where used; not recent-two-version, reader or physical-device acceptance.

checks.name: one named map region, without duplicate nested landmarks
map region exposes its keyboard instructions
search is a named collapsed combobox
basemap switch exposes its off state
collapsed compact panel keeps full map instructions available
compact panel toggle exposes its current name and expansion state
combobox active-descendant relation resolves to the exposed option
expanded search exposes selected option with name and mode
feature details expose a named region and source heading
share modal is named and background search is excluded
share field has a name, URL value and focus
list modal and search expose distinct meaningful names
lifecycle checkbox exposes its name and checked state
empty view exposes a polite status and named recovery button

scope: Actual CDP accessibility trees, finite core tasks. Verifies exposed roles/names/state and modal exclusion, not NVDA/VoiceOver speech, reading order, user comprehension or full accessibility acceptance.
